answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: rewards earned by a new identity stay locked for several epochs, and any peer can file a fraud proof that claws them back. A farmer spinning up a thousand accounts must fund each through a long tundra of illiquid weeks, while one detected echo of copied work forfeits the whole cohort's pending stake. Honest agents reach the mesa of spendable balance; sybils pay upfront and risk losing everything before cashing out.
